TDD Anchor entries list test names as `VariableTemplateRendererTest::methodName` without a full file path prefix. The preamble sentence mentions the file path, but individual bullet entries should follow the format `\`path/to/TestFile.java::test_name\` — description` so the implementing agent can locate each test unambiguously.
findings.fix: Prefix each bullet with the full path: `` `backend/src/test/java/com/botfunnel/funnel/VariableTemplateRendererTest.java::substitutesUserFields` — description``.

findings.issue: The Automated subsection and the Smoke subsection contain the identical command: `cd backend && ./gradlew test --tests '*TelegramSender*'`. The Smoke step adds no distinct check beyond what Automated already runs, making it redundant. The tech-spec Verify-smoke for Task 3 mentions checking block/delete-flip, terminal exceptions, and token no-leak — these are already covered by the TDD Anchor tests, but the Smoke section should describe how to verify them (e.g. which test class to look at), not repeat the exact same shell command.
findings.fix: Keep Automated as-is. Rewrite Smoke to reference the specific MockWebServer scenarios from TDD Anchor that verify the failure matrix (403 flip, 400-chat-not-found flip, token no-leak assertion) and note which test method names confirm each property, so a reviewer can target them explicitly.
